# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 D3 colonisation framework (phase 1, resettlement). Generated by gen_colonization.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# 2026-11-19 v6.6 D3 phase 2 (foreign settlers: events 3, 11, 12, 14; the discount interface oe_col_offer_discount) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-19 v6.6 D3 phase 3 (the Black Sea trading posts: events 20-24, the actions oe_col_open_post and oe_col_close_post, the building oe_col_emporion) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-20 v6.7 D3 phase 4a (the Roman colonia: oe_col_found_colonia, events 30-31) added to this file by the same generator.

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_loc saved. oe_col_group = the group the target can take (1 Albanians, 2 Cumans, 3 Armenians, 4 Alans), the local one first; none: the variable is removed and option b of oe_col.1 does not show.
oe_col_pick_group = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_group } remove_variable = oe_col_group }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_g1_ok = yes scope:oe_col_loc ?= { oe_col_albanian_lands = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_col_g3_ok = yes scope:oe_col_loc ?= { oe_col_east_lands = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_col_g2_ok = yes }
        random_list = {
            50 = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 2 } }
            50 = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 4 } }
        }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_col_g1_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_col_g3_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = 3 } }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_loc saved. New pops of group var:oe_col_group at the target: peasants 1.0 and soldiers 0.3 (thousands). Phase 2's events reuse it.
oe_col_add_settlers = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_group ?= 1 }
            scope:oe_col_loc = {
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:albanian
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:peasants
                    size = 1.0
                }
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:albanian
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:soldiers
                    size = 0.3
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_group ?= 2 }
            scope:oe_col_loc = {
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:cuman_culture
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:peasants
                    size = 1.0
                }
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:cuman_culture
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:soldiers
                    size = 0.3
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_group ?= 3 }
            scope:oe_col_loc = {
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:armenian_culture
                    religion = religion:miaphysite
                    type = pop_type:peasants
                    size = 1.0
                }
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:armenian_culture
                    religion = religion:miaphysite
                    type = pop_type:soldiers
                    size = 0.3
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_group ?= 4 }
            scope:oe_col_loc = {
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:alan_culture
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:peasants
                    size = 1.0
                }
                add_pop = {
                    culture = culture:alan_culture
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    type = pop_type:soldiers
                    size = 0.3
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Event counter oe_dbg_n_col (test page).
oe_col_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_col } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_col value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_col add = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope, the first month. Starts the books.
oe_col_init = {
    set_variable = oe_col_on
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_n_settled } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_n_settled value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_pop_added } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added value = 0 }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_col } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_col value = 0 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Each migration slot counts down; at 0 the move is over: oe_col_n_settled +1 and, while the place is still ours, a quarrel is queued there (60 % after foreign settlers, 40 % after an internal move; due 12-24 months later).
oe_col_slot_tick = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_m add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_s1_m <= 0 }
            var:oe_col_s1_loc ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
                    if = {
                        limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_col_s1_kind ?= 2 } }
                        random = {
                            chance = 60
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp value = 2 }
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due value = { integer_range = { min = 12 max = 24 } } }
                            change_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due add = oe_ml_month_now }
                            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        random = {
                            chance = 40
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp value = 1 }
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due value = { integer_range = { min = 12 max = 24 } } }
                            change_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due add = oe_ml_month_now }
                            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_n_settled } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_n_settled value = 0 }
            }
            change_variable = { name = oe_col_n_settled add = 1 }
            remove_variable = oe_col_s1_loc
            remove_variable = oe_col_s1_m
            remove_variable = oe_col_s1_kind
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_m add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_s2_m <= 0 }
            var:oe_col_s2_loc ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
                    if = {
                        limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_col_s2_kind ?= 2 } }
                        random = {
                            chance = 60
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp value = 2 }
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due value = { integer_range = { min = 12 max = 24 } } }
                            change_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due add = oe_ml_month_now }
                            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        random = {
                            chance = 40
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp value = 1 }
                            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due value = { integer_range = { min = 12 max = 24 } } }
                            change_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_due add = oe_ml_month_now }
                            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_n_settled } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_n_settled value = 0 }
            }
            change_variable = { name = oe_col_n_settled add = 1 }
            remove_variable = oe_col_s2_loc
            remove_variable = oe_col_s2_m
            remove_variable = oe_col_s2_kind
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Drops stale quarrels (the settlers' modifiers are gone) and the flag when none is left.
oe_col_dsp_clean = {
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_col_dsp
            NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_homesteads }
            NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_col_dsp
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_due } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_due }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { any_owned_location = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp } } } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_dsp_pick saved. That place's quarrel becomes the one of oe_col.2 (oe_col_dsp_loc, oe_col_dsp_kind) and leaves the queue.
oe_col_dsp_take = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_loc value = scope:oe_col_dsp_pick }
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_kind value = scope:oe_col_dsp_pick.var:oe_col_dsp }
    scope:oe_col_dsp_pick = {
        remove_variable = oe_col_dsp
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_due } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_due }
    }
}

# Location scope. scope:oe_col_theme = the theme whose jurisdiction holds this place (none: unset).
oe_col_save_theme = {
    random_buildings_in_location = {
        limit = { oe_theme_building_trigger = yes owner ?= { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } }
        owner = { save_scope_as = oe_col_theme }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_loc saved. scope:oe_col_src = Byzantium's most populous province that does not hold the target; scope:oe_col_amt = its monthly amount (oe_col_mig_amount).
oe_col_find_source = {
    scope:oe_col_loc ?= { province = { save_scope_as = oe_col_dst_prov } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_dst_prov }
        ordered_province = {
            limit = { NOT = { this = scope:oe_col_dst_prov } }
            order_by = population
            save_scope_as = oe_col_src
        }
    }
    scope:oe_col_src ?= { save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_col_amt value = oe_col_mig_amount } }
}

# BYZ scope. scope:oe_col_loc = var:oe_col_target, with its theme, the source of an internal move and the group of foreign settlers; readouts oe_col_t_pop and oe_col_t_total for the texts.
oe_col_save_target = {
    var:oe_col_target ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
    scope:oe_col_loc ?= { oe_col_save_theme = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_t_pop value = scope:oe_col_loc.population }
    }
    oe_col_find_source = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_amt }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_t_total value = { value = scope:oe_col_amt multiply = 24 } }
    }
    oe_col_pick_group = yes
}

# BYZ scope. oe_col.10: scope:oe_col_city = where the Nicomedian refugees live (the start event's modifier, Constantinople first); scope:oe_col_loc = their new home: the least populous sparse land in Thrace, else the first sparse land (oe_col_pick_score). Kept in oe_col_nic_city / oe_col_nic_to for the worker.
oe_col_save_nic = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ has_location_modifier = oe_s37_nic_refugees } }
        location:constantinople = { save_scope_as = oe_col_city }
    }
    else = {
        random_owned_location = {
            limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_s37_nic_refugees }
            save_scope_as = oe_col_city
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { any_owned_location = { oe_col_sparse = yes oe_col_in_thrace = yes } }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { oe_col_sparse = yes oe_col_in_thrace = yes }
            order_by = oe_col_low_pop
            save_scope_as = oe_col_loc
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_col_has_sparse = yes }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { oe_col_sparse = yes }
            order_by = oe_col_pick_score
            save_scope_as = oe_col_loc
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_city }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_nic_city value = scope:oe_col_city }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc } set_variable = { name = oe_col_nic_to value = scope:oe_col_loc } }
    else = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_nic_to } remove_variable = oe_col_nic_to } }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.1 if its trigger holds (the choice of settlers (action, AI, test page); no quiet months after it): takes the main-line month (line 16) so no other main-line event follows this month.
oe_col_fire_1 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_1 = yes }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.1
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.2 if its trigger holds (the quarrel; 6 quiet months after it): takes the main-line month (line 16) so no other main-line event follows this month.
oe_col_fire_2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_2 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_ev_cd months = 6 }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.2
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.10 if its trigger holds (the Nicomedian refugees (once); 6 quiet months after it): takes the main-line month (line 16) so no other main-line event follows this month.
oe_col_fire_10 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_10 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_ev_cd months = 6 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_fired_10 value = 1 }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.10
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_pick saved (a sparse location). Starts a resettlement: costs 2 Imperial Authority, the action cools down 24 months (12 while the discount lasts), oe_col.1 opens for that place.
oe_col_start = {
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -2 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_target value = scope:oe_col_pick }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_discount } set_variable = { name = oe_col_act_cd months = 12 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_act_cd months = 24 } }
    oe_col_fire_1 = yes
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. oe_col.10 while the start event's refugees modifier lasts (20 % a month when the line is free); once it is gone unfired, oe_col_fired_10 = 2 (dropped).
oe_col_try_10 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_10 } current_date >= 1338.1.1 }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_10 = yes }
            if = { limit = { oe_col_ev_free = yes } random = { chance = 20 oe_col_fire_10 = yes } }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_fired_10 value = 2 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The first due quarrel becomes oe_col.2 when the line is free.
oe_col_try_2 = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_on } oe_col_dsp_clean = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_on oe_col_ev_free = yes any_owned_location = { oe_col_dsp_ready = yes } }
        random_owned_location = { limit = { oe_col_dsp_ready = yes } save_scope_as = oe_col_dsp_pick }
        oe_col_dsp_take = yes
        oe_col_fire_2 = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. The AI's roll (20 %): the first sparse place (reclaimed land first, then the least populous) gets oe_col.1, as if the action had been used.
oe_col_ai_year = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ai_ok = yes }
        random = {
            chance = 20
            ordered_owned_location = {
                limit = { oe_col_sparse = yes }
                order_by = oe_col_pick_score
                save_scope_as = oe_col_pick
            }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_pick } oe_col_start = yes }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. One debug-log line with phase 1's state (for the observer logger of the test mod).
oe_col_log = {
    debug_log = "OE_COL p1 sparse=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_sparse_n')|0] slots=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_slots_used')|0] s1=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_s1_m').GetValue|0] s2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_s2_m').GetValue|0] settled=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_n_settled').GetValue|0] pop=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_pop_added').GetValue|1] nic=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_fired_10').GetValue|0] quarrels=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_dsp_n')|0] events=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_dbg_n_col').GetValue|0]"
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Clears the line's variables on BYZ and its places (cooldowns, slots, queued quarrels); modifiers and people already added stay.
oe_col_test_reset = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_on } remove_variable = oe_col_on }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_act_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_act_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_ev_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_ev_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_target } remove_variable = oe_col_target }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_job } remove_variable = oe_col_job }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_group } remove_variable = oe_col_group }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_s1_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_m } remove_variable = oe_col_s1_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_kind } remove_variable = oe_col_s1_kind }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_s2_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_m } remove_variable = oe_col_s2_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_kind } remove_variable = oe_col_s2_kind }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_n_settled } remove_variable = oe_col_n_settled }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_pop_added } remove_variable = oe_col_pop_added }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_10 } remove_variable = oe_col_fired_10 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_on } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_on }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_kind } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_kind }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_t_pop } remove_variable = oe_col_t_pop }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_t_total } remove_variable = oe_col_t_total }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_nic_city } remove_variable = oe_col_nic_city }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_nic_to } remove_variable = oe_col_nic_to }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_nic_choice } remove_variable = oe_col_nic_choice }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_11 } remove_variable = oe_col_fired_11 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_12 } remove_variable = oe_col_fired_12 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_14 } remove_variable = oe_col_fired_14 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c11 } remove_variable = oe_col_c11 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c12 } remove_variable = oe_col_c12 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c14 } remove_variable = oe_col_c14 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_ths_1 } remove_variable = oe_col_ths_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_ths_2 } remove_variable = oe_col_ths_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_mor_1 } remove_variable = oe_col_mor_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_mor_2 } remove_variable = oe_col_mor_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_mor_3 } remove_variable = oe_col_mor_3 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_stp_to } remove_variable = oe_col_stp_to }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_stp_g } remove_variable = oe_col_stp_g }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_p2_group } remove_variable = oe_col_p2_group }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_group_keep } remove_variable = oe_col_group_keep }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_sons_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_sons_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_sons_at } remove_variable = oe_col_sons_at }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_discount } remove_variable = oe_col_discount }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_test_stp } remove_variable = oe_col_test_stp }
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                has_variable = oe_col_cd
                has_variable = oe_col_dsp
                has_variable = oe_col_dsp_due
                has_variable = oe_col_kind
                has_variable = oe_col_young
                has_variable = oe_col_sons_done
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp_due } remove_variable = oe_col_dsp_due }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_kind } remove_variable = oe_col_kind }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_young } remove_variable = oe_col_young }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_sons_done } remove_variable = oe_col_sons_done }
    }
    oe_col_test_posts_reset = yes
    oe_col_test_p4_reset = yes
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. oe_col.1 for the first sparse place, without the authority cost or the action's cooldown.
oe_col_test_fire_1 = {
    ordered_owned_location = {
        limit = { oe_col_sparse = yes }
        order_by = oe_col_pick_score
        save_scope_as = oe_col_pick
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_target value = scope:oe_col_pick }
        oe_col_fire_1 = yes
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Both migration slots end now (a quarrel may be queued).
oe_col_test_slots = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_m value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_m value = 1 } }
    oe_col_slot_tick = yes
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. oe_col.2 at once: a queued place (not waiting for its month), else any place of ours with this line's settlers.
oe_col_test_fire_2 = {
    random_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp } save_scope_as = oe_col_dsp_pick }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_dsp_pick } oe_col_dsp_take = yes oe_col_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_location = {
                OR = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_homesteads has_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers }
            }
        }
        random_owned_location = {
            limit = {
                OR = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_homesteads has_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_col_dsp_pick
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_loc value = scope:oe_col_dsp_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_kind value = 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_col_dsp_pick = { NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers } } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_dsp_kind value = 1 }
        }
        oe_col_fire_2 = yes
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. oe_col.10 at once (no window, no roll); with no refugees modifier anywhere, Constantinople gets the start event's modifier for a year first.
oe_col_test_fire_10 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_owned_location = { has_location_modifier = oe_s37_nic_refugees } } }
        location:constantinople = {
            if = {
                limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_s37_nic_refugees years = 1 mode = replace }
            }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_10 } remove_variable = oe_col_fired_10 }
    oe_col_fire_10 = yes
}

# INTERFACE for L5 (the Black Death line, not built yet). BYZ scope; years = N. For N years resettlement is cheaper: oe_col_cost_in and oe_col_cost_out are halved and the action cools down in 12 months instead of 24 (BYZ var oe_col_discount, with that duration; a new call replaces the old one). A cooldown already running is not shortened.
oe_col_offer_discount = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_discount value = 1 years = $years$ }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_loc saved; var:oe_col_p2_group = the group (GROUPS). Foreign soldier families settle there as in oe_col.1 b: phase 1's oe_col_add_settlers (unchanged) adds the people, then the same modifiers, marks (oe_col_cd, oe_col_kind = 2, oe_col_young) and books; no migration slot is taken. var:oe_col_group belongs to oe_col.1, which may be open: it is put back afterwards.
oe_col_settle_p2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_p2_group exists = scope:oe_col_loc scope:oe_col_loc = { oe_col_site = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_col_group }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_group_keep value = var:oe_col_group }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = var:oe_col_p2_group }
        oe_col_add_settlers = yes
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_pop_added } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added value = 0 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added add = 1.3 }
        scope:oe_col_loc = {
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers years = 20 mode = replace }
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_newcomers years = 5 mode = replace }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_young years = 10 }
        }
        scope:oe_col_loc = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_cd years = 20 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_kind value = 2 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_col_group_keep }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_group value = var:oe_col_group_keep }
            remove_variable = oe_col_group_keep
        }
        else = { remove_variable = oe_col_group }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_col.11: the 2 least populous places of ours in Thessaly (scope:oe_col_a1, oe_col_a2; BYZ var oe_col_ths_1, oe_col_ths_2).
oe_col_save_ths = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_ths_1 } remove_variable = oe_col_ths_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_ths_2 } remove_variable = oe_col_ths_2 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            province_definition:thessaly_province = {
                any_location_in_province_definition = { count >= 1 oe_col_site = yes }
            }
        }
        province_definition:thessaly_province = {
            ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
                limit = { oe_col_site = yes }
                order_by = oe_col_low_pop
                save_scope_as = oe_col_a1
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_a1 } set_variable = { name = oe_col_ths_1 value = scope:oe_col_a1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            province_definition:thessaly_province = {
                any_location_in_province_definition = { count >= 2 oe_col_site = yes }
            }
        }
        province_definition:thessaly_province = {
            ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
                limit = { oe_col_site = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_col_a1 } }
                order_by = oe_col_low_pop
                save_scope_as = oe_col_a2
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_a2 } set_variable = { name = oe_col_ths_2 value = scope:oe_col_a2 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_col.12: up to 3 places of ours in Arcadia, the least populous first (scope:oe_col_a1..; BYZ var oe_col_mor_1..), and scope:oe_col_theme = the theme that holds Mistra, if any.
oe_col_save_mor = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_mor_1 } remove_variable = oe_col_mor_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_mor_2 } remove_variable = oe_col_mor_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_mor_3 } remove_variable = oe_col_mor_3 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            province_definition:arcadia_province = {
                any_location_in_province_definition = { count >= 1 oe_col_site = yes }
            }
        }
        province_definition:arcadia_province = {
            ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
                limit = { oe_col_site = yes }
                order_by = oe_col_low_pop
                save_scope_as = oe_col_a1
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_a1 } set_variable = { name = oe_col_mor_1 value = scope:oe_col_a1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            province_definition:arcadia_province = {
                any_location_in_province_definition = { count >= 2 oe_col_site = yes }
            }
        }
        province_definition:arcadia_province = {
            ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
                limit = { oe_col_site = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_col_a1 } }
                order_by = oe_col_low_pop
                save_scope_as = oe_col_a2
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_a2 } set_variable = { name = oe_col_mor_2 value = scope:oe_col_a2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            province_definition:arcadia_province = {
                any_location_in_province_definition = { count >= 3 oe_col_site = yes }
            }
        }
        province_definition:arcadia_province = {
            ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
                limit = { oe_col_site = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_col_a1 } NOT = { this = scope:oe_col_a2 } }
                order_by = oe_col_low_pop
                save_scope_as = oe_col_a3
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_a3 } set_variable = { name = oe_col_mor_3 value = scope:oe_col_a3 } }
    }
    location:mystras = { oe_col_save_theme = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_col.14: scope:oe_col_loc = the sparse place in Thrace or on the Danube that takes the riders (reclaimed land first, then the least populous; BYZ var oe_col_stp_to) and who they are (BYZ var oe_col_stp_g: 2 Cumans, 4 Alans, half and half as in oe_col_pick_group).
oe_col_save_stp = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_stp_to } remove_variable = oe_col_stp_to }
    if = {
        limit = { any_owned_location = { oe_col_stp_land = yes } }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { oe_col_stp_land = yes }
            order_by = oe_col_pick_score
            save_scope_as = oe_col_loc
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc } set_variable = { name = oe_col_stp_to value = scope:oe_col_loc } }
    random_list = {
        50 = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_stp_g value = 2 } }
        50 = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_stp_g value = 4 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_sons_pick saved. That place becomes the one of oe_col.3 (BYZ var oe_col_sons_at, which the event's trigger and the worker read) and the candidate is used up (as oe_col_dsp_take does for the quarrel).
oe_col_sons_take = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_sons_at value = scope:oe_col_sons_pick }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_sons_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_sons_loc }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_col.3: scope:oe_col_loc = the place (BYZ var oe_col_sons_at) with its theme; the place is marked oe_col_sons_done at once, whatever the answer.
oe_col_save_sons = {
    var:oe_col_sons_at ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc oe_col_save_theme = yes set_variable = oe_col_sons_done }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.3 if its trigger holds (the soldiers' sons; 6 quiet months after it): takes the main-line month (line 16).
oe_col_fire_3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_3 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_ev_cd months = 6 }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.3
    }
}

    }

# BYZ scope, monthly. oe_col.11 once in 1338.6.1 - 1350.12.31 (8 % a month while Byzantium holds two places of Thessaly and the line is free); after the window, oe_col_fired_11 = 2 (dropped).
oe_col_try_11 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_11 } current_date >= 1338.6.1 }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1351.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_col_fired_11 value = 2 } }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_11 = yes oe_col_ev_free = yes }
            random = { chance = 8 oe_col_fire_11 = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. oe_col.14 once in 1360.1.1 - 1390.12.31 (5 % a month while steppe riders may come, there is sparse land for them and the line is free); after it, oe_col_fired_14 = 2.
oe_col_try_14 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_14 } current_date >= 1360.1.1 }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1391.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_col_fired_14 value = 2 } }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_14 = yes oe_col_ev_free = yes }
            random = { chance = 5 oe_col_fire_14 = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. oe_col.12 once in 1394.1.1 - 1405.12.31 (10 % a month while the bloc holds Mistra, Byzantium a place of Arcadia and the line is free; from 1405.1.1, the last year, without the roll); after it, oe_col_fired_12 = 2.
oe_col_try_12 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_12 } current_date >= 1394.1.1 }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1406.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_col_fired_12 value = 2 } }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_12 = yes oe_col_ev_free = yes }
            if = { limit = { current_date >= 1405.1.1 } oe_col_fire_12 = yes }
            else = { random = { chance = 10 oe_col_fire_12 = yes } }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. The search for 'the soldiers' sons' (30 %): one ready place becomes the candidate (BYZ var oe_col_sons_loc) and waits for the line's turn (oe_col_try_3).
oe_col_sons_year = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_sons_loc } any_owned_location = { oe_col_sons_ready = yes } }
        random = {
            chance = 30
            random_owned_location = { limit = { oe_col_sons_ready = yes } save_scope_as = oe_col_sons_pick }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_sons_loc value = scope:oe_col_sons_pick }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The candidate of oe_col_sons_year gets oe_col.3 when the line is free; a candidate that is no longer ready (lost, or settled again) is dropped.
oe_col_try_3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_sons_loc }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:oe_col_sons_loc ?= { oe_col_sons_ready = yes } } }
            remove_variable = oe_col_sons_loc
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_col_ev_free = yes }
            var:oe_col_sons_loc = { save_scope_as = oe_col_sons_pick }
            oe_col_sons_take = yes
            oe_col_fire_3 = yes
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. One debug-log line with phase 2's state (for the observer logger of the test mod).
oe_col_log_p2 = {
    debug_log = "OE_COL p2 f11=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_fired_11').GetValue|0] c11=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_c11').GetValue|0] f14=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_fired_14').GetValue|0] c14=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_c14').GetValue|0] f12=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_fired_12').GetValue|0] c12=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_c12').GetValue|0] foreign=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_foreign_n')|0] sons=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_sons_n')|0] discount=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_disc_v')|0]"
}

# Any scope. The six sites go on the list oe_col_sites (for ordered_in_list / random_in_list, always with a limit: the list outlives the call).
oe_col_list_sites = {
    location:tana = { add_to_list = oe_col_sites }
    location:kaffa = { add_to_list = oe_col_sites }
    location:trebizond = { add_to_list = oe_col_sites }
    location:sinop = { add_to_list = oe_col_sites }
    location:varna = { add_to_list = oe_col_sites }
    location:chilia = { add_to_list = oe_col_sites }
    location:famagusta = { add_to_list = oe_col_sites }
    location:alexandria = { add_to_list = oe_col_sites }
    location:beirut = { add_to_list = oe_col_sites }
}

# Location scope (a site). A level-1 post opens: Byzantium goes on the owner's list of admitted countries (oe_col_admitted), the emporion is built at once, the books start (level, month, order, host).
oe_col_post_open = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_owner = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_col_admits_byz = yes } }
            add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_col_admitted target = c:BYZ }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes } }
            construct_building = {
                building_type = building_type:oe_col_emporion
                owner = c:BYZ
                instant = yes
                cost_multiplier = 0
                cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_since value = oe_ml_month_now }
        owner = { save_scope_as = oe_col_new_host }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_host value = scope:oe_col_new_host }
        c:BYZ = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_seq } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_seq value = 0 }
            }
            change_variable = { name = oe_col_post_seq add = 1 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_seq value = c:BYZ.var:oe_col_post_seq }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_lost } remove_variable = oe_col_post_lost }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_thr_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_post_thr_cd }
    }
}

# Location scope. The post here becomes a chartered quarter (level 2): the location modifier oe_col_emporion_fort while it lasts.
oe_col_post_fortify = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post value = 2 }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_emporion_fort years = -1 mode = replace }
    }
}

# Location scope; why = 0 closed by us, or the reason of oe_col.22 (1 war with the host, 2 Tana ruined, 3 a hostile new owner, 4 no upkeep, 5 Gazaria fallen). The post here ends: Byzantium is struck off the list (the building's remove_if then takes the emporion down; it is destroyed here as well), the site's books are cleared, the site cools down 60 months (Tana's ruin: 120), and a lost post is queued for oe_col.22.
oe_col_post_drop = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_since } remove_variable = oe_col_post_since }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_seq } remove_variable = oe_col_post_seq }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_host } remove_variable = oe_col_post_host }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_susp } remove_variable = oe_col_post_susp }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } remove_variable = oe_col_post_own }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_rb } remove_variable = oe_col_post_rb }
        remove_variable = oe_col_post
        if = { limit = { oe_col_admits_byz = yes } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_col_admitted target = c:BYZ } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes }
            destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_col_emporion|c:BYZ)"
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_emporion_fort }
            remove_location_modifier = oe_col_emporion_fort
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_cd } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_cd months = 60 }
        }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_col_why value = $why$ }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_col_why > 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_lost value = scope:oe_col_why }
            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_col_lost_on }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The books of the posts, from the sites: the mirrors oe_col_post_<site> (0-2; the names of design 3.8, for other lines and the readouts), the points oe_col_posts_n (level 1 = 1, level 2 = 2; suspended posts do not count) and oe_col_grain_posts (Varna, Kilia, Caffa, Tana; D1's grain road reads it), and the one of the three modifiers oe_col_emporia_1/2/3 that fits the points (1; 2-3; 4 and more).
oe_col_post_count = {
    if = { limit = { location:tana = { var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_tana value = 2 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:tana = { var:oe_col_post ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_tana value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_tana value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:kaffa = { var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_kaffa value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:kaffa = { var:oe_col_post ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_kaffa value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_kaffa value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:trebizond = { var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_trebizond value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:trebizond = { var:oe_col_post ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_trebizond value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_trebizond value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:sinop = { var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_sinop value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:sinop = { var:oe_col_post ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_sinop value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_sinop value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:varna = { var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_varna value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:varna = { var:oe_col_post ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_varna value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_varna value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:chilia = { var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_chilia value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:chilia = { var:oe_col_post ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_chilia value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_chilia value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:famagusta = { var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_famagusta value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:famagusta = { var:oe_col_post ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_famagusta value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_famagusta value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:alexandria = { var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_alexandria value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:alexandria = { var:oe_col_post ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_alexandria value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_alexandria value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:beirut = { var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_beirut value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:beirut = { var:oe_col_post ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_beirut value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_beirut value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_posts_n value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_grain_posts value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { location:tana = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_posts_n add = var:oe_col_post_tana }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_grain_posts add = var:oe_col_post_tana }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:kaffa = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_posts_n add = var:oe_col_post_kaffa }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_grain_posts add = var:oe_col_post_kaffa }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:trebizond = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_posts_n add = var:oe_col_post_trebizond }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:sinop = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_posts_n add = var:oe_col_post_sinop }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:varna = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_posts_n add = var:oe_col_post_varna }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_grain_posts add = var:oe_col_post_varna }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:chilia = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_posts_n add = var:oe_col_post_chilia }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_grain_posts add = var:oe_col_post_chilia }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:famagusta = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_posts_n add = var:oe_col_post_famagusta }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:alexandria = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_posts_n add = var:oe_col_post_alexandria }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:beirut = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_col_posts_n add = var:oe_col_post_beirut }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_col_posts_n = 1 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_col_emporia_1 } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_emporia_1 years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_col_posts_n = 1 } has_country_modifier = oe_col_emporia_1 }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_col_emporia_1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_col_posts_n >= 2 var:oe_col_posts_n <= 3 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_col_emporia_2 } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_emporia_2 years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { AND = { var:oe_col_posts_n >= 2 var:oe_col_posts_n <= 3 } }
            has_country_modifier = oe_col_emporia_2
        }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_col_emporia_2
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_col_posts_n >= 4 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_col_emporia_3 } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_emporia_3 years = -1 mode = add }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_col_posts_n >= 4 } has_country_modifier = oe_col_emporia_3 }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_col_emporia_3
    }
}

# Location scope (a site), monthly. Design 3.5.1 and section 0.5 of the notes. Tana's ruin (C4's global oe_glh_tana_ruined; once): the site cools down 120 months and a post there is lost (2). A post: our own port while the imperial bloc holds the site (phase 4a, design 3.6.3: held by Byzantium itself, it becomes a colonia once, oe_col_site_colonia); else lost when the site has no owner (3), its owner is at war with us (1), Gazaria has fallen (5), or it changed hands to an owner whose opinion of us is under -25 (3); a new owner who bears with us becomes the host. Suspended while trade there is shut (oe_col_site_shut), open again when that ends. A missing house is built once more (oe_col_post_rb).
oe_col_site_sync = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            this = location:tana
            has_global_variable = oe_glh_tana_ruined
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_ruin_seen }
        }
        set_variable = oe_col_ruin_seen
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_cd months = 120 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post } oe_col_post_drop = { why = 2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post }
        if = {
            limit = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } } set_variable = oe_col_post_own }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_susp } remove_variable = oe_col_post_susp }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
                    owner ?= c:BYZ
                    location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
                }
                oe_col_site_colonia = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { has_owner = no } oe_col_post_drop = { why = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { owner ?= { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } } oe_col_post_drop = { why = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_col_site_fallen = yes } oe_col_post_drop = { why = 5 } }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } remove_variable = oe_col_post_own }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
            var:oe_col_post_host ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_host0 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_host owner ?= { NOT = { this = scope:oe_col_host0 } } }
                if = {
                    limit = { owner ?= { NOT = { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= -25 } } } }
                    oe_col_post_drop = { why = 3 }
                }
                else = {
                    owner = { save_scope_as = oe_col_new_host }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_host value = scope:oe_col_new_host }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_col_site_shut = yes }
                    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_susp } } set_variable = oe_col_post_susp }
                }
                else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_susp } remove_variable = oe_col_post_susp }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { oe_col_admits_byz = yes } }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_col_admitted target = c:BYZ }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes } NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_rb } }
                    set_variable = oe_col_post_rb
                    construct_building = {
                        building_type = building_type:oe_col_emporion
                        owner = c:BYZ
                        instant = yes
                        cost_multiplier = 0
                        cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The request under way is over.
oe_col_req_clear = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_req_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_due } remove_variable = oe_col_req_due }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_paid } remove_variable = oe_col_req_paid }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_ans } remove_variable = oe_col_ans }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_pick_site saved (a site that passes oe_col_site_ok). OUR REQUEST (action and AI): 2 authority and oe_col_cost_post gold (no gold while the opening voucher lasts; it is used up when the post opens), then THE HOST'S EVENT oe_col.24 for the owner of the site. No answer in 2 months: oe_col_req_fallback.
oe_col_request = {
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -2 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_voucher } set_variable = { name = oe_col_req_paid value = 0 } }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_req_paid value = oe_col_cost_post }
        add_gold = { value = oe_col_cost_post multiply = -1 }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_req_loc value = scope:oe_col_pick_site }
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_req_due value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_ans } remove_variable = oe_col_ans }
    scope:oe_col_pick_site = { owner ?= { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.24 } }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.20 if its trigger holds (the empire's merchant ships (once); 6 quiet months after it): takes the main-line month (line 16).
oe_col_fire_20 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_20 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_ev_cd months = 6 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_fired_20 value = 1 }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.20
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.21 if its trigger holds (the host's answer; must-fire, no quiet months): takes the main-line month (line 16).
oe_col_fire_21 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_21 = yes }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.21
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.22 if its trigger holds (a post lost; must-fire, no quiet months): takes the main-line month (line 16).
oe_col_fire_22 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_22 = yes }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.22
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.23 if its trigger holds (a thriving post; 6 quiet months after it): takes the main-line month (line 16).
oe_col_fire_23 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_23 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_ev_cd months = 6 }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.23
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The host has not answered in 2 months (its event did not come, or was left open): the answer is rolled here as design 3.5.3 has it (oe_col_host_ch; a host on Genoa's side that would refuse asks a price instead in 50 % of the cases), then oe_col.21. A site that can no longer take a post: the gold comes back and the request ends.
oe_col_req_fallback = {
    var:oe_col_req_loc ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_site }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_site scope:oe_col_site = { oe_col_site_can_open = yes } }
        scope:oe_col_site = { save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_col_ch value = oe_col_host_ch } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_ans value = 3 }
        random = { chance = scope:oe_col_ch set_variable = { name = oe_col_ans value = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_ans ?= 3 oe_col_price_ok = yes }
            random = { chance = 50 set_variable = { name = oe_col_ans value = 2 } }
        }
        oe_col_fire_21 = yes
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_paid } add_gold = var:oe_col_req_paid }
        oe_col_req_clear = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly (with or without Constantinople). Looks at the six sites (oe_col_site_sync), brings the books up to date (oe_col_post_count), answers a request the host left unanswered for 2 months (oe_col_req_fallback) and pays out a claim that was granted (oe_col.22 a).
oe_col_post_sync = {
    location:tana = { oe_col_site_sync = yes }
    location:kaffa = { oe_col_site_sync = yes }
    location:trebizond = { oe_col_site_sync = yes }
    location:sinop = { oe_col_site_sync = yes }
    location:varna = { oe_col_site_sync = yes }
    location:chilia = { oe_col_site_sync = yes }
    location:famagusta = { oe_col_site_sync = yes }
    location:alexandria = { oe_col_site_sync = yes }
    location:beirut = { oe_col_site_sync = yes }
    oe_col_post_count = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_col_req_loc
            has_variable = oe_col_req_due
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_ans }
            var:oe_col_req_due <= oe_ml_month_now
        }
        oe_col_req_fallback = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_claim_due var:oe_col_claim_due <= oe_ml_month_now }
        add_gold = oe_col_m1
        remove_variable = oe_col_claim_due
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly, MUST-FIRE (before the optional events; it does not wait for the lock but takes it): the first lost post in the queue becomes oe_col.22 (BYZ var oe_col_lost_loc, oe_col_lost_why). One a month.
oe_col_try_22 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_lost_on }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_col_any_lost = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { location:tana = { has_variable = oe_col_post_lost } }
                location:tana = { save_scope_as = oe_col_lost_pick }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { location:kaffa = { has_variable = oe_col_post_lost } }
                location:kaffa = { save_scope_as = oe_col_lost_pick }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { location:trebizond = { has_variable = oe_col_post_lost } }
                location:trebizond = { save_scope_as = oe_col_lost_pick }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { location:sinop = { has_variable = oe_col_post_lost } }
                location:sinop = { save_scope_as = oe_col_lost_pick }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { location:varna = { has_variable = oe_col_post_lost } }
                location:varna = { save_scope_as = oe_col_lost_pick }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { location:chilia = { has_variable = oe_col_post_lost } }
                location:chilia = { save_scope_as = oe_col_lost_pick }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { location:famagusta = { has_variable = oe_col_post_lost } }
                location:famagusta = { save_scope_as = oe_col_lost_pick }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { location:alexandria = { has_variable = oe_col_post_lost } }
                location:alexandria = { save_scope_as = oe_col_lost_pick }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { location:beirut = { has_variable = oe_col_post_lost } }
                location:beirut = { save_scope_as = oe_col_lost_pick }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_lost_loc value = scope:oe_col_lost_pick }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_lost_why value = scope:oe_col_lost_pick.var:oe_col_post_lost }
            scope:oe_col_lost_pick = { remove_variable = oe_col_post_lost }
            oe_col_fire_22 = yes
        }
        else = { remove_variable = oe_col_lost_on }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. oe_col.20 once, after the Galata chain (oe_s37_gal_done) or from 1352.1.1, until 1365.12.31 (10 % a month when the line is free). From 1366.1.1 unfired: the action opens without the event (oe_col_fired_20 = 2).
oe_col_try_20 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fired_20 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_c_open } }
        if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1366.1.1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_fired_20 value = 2 }
            set_variable = oe_col_c_open
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_done current_date >= 1352.1.1 } oe_col_ev_free = yes }
            random = { chance = 10 oe_col_fire_20 = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The candidate of oe_col_thr_year gets oe_col.23 when the line is free; one that is no longer ready is dropped.
oe_col_try_23 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_thr_loc }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:oe_col_thr_loc ?= { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes } } }
            remove_variable = oe_col_thr_loc
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_col_ev_free = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_thr_at value = var:oe_col_thr_loc }
            remove_variable = oe_col_thr_loc
            oe_col_fire_23 = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. The search for 'a thriving post' (20 %): one ready post becomes the candidate (BYZ var oe_col_thr_loc) and waits for the line's turn (oe_col_try_23).
oe_col_thr_year = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_thr_loc }
            OR = {
                location:tana = { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes }
                location:kaffa = { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes }
                location:trebizond = { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes }
                location:sinop = { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes }
                location:varna = { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes }
                location:chilia = { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes }
                location:famagusta = { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes }
                location:alexandria = { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes }
                location:beirut = { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes }
            }
        }
        random = {
            chance = 20
            oe_col_list_sites = yes
            random_in_list = {
                list = oe_col_sites
                limit = { oe_col_post_thr_ready = yes }
                save_scope_as = oe_col_thr_pick
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_thr_pick }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_thr_loc value = scope:oe_col_thr_pick }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. The upkeep of the posts (oe_col_upkeep: 0.5 of a month of income a point). If the gold is not there, the newest paying post closes (oe_col.22, reason 4) and the rest is paid if it can be.
oe_col_post_upkeep = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_upkeep_pts > 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { gold < oe_col_upkeep }
            oe_col_list_sites = yes
            ordered_in_list = {
                list = oe_col_sites
                limit = { oe_col_post_pays = yes }
                order_by = oe_col_seq_v
                max = 1
                check_range_bounds = no
                oe_col_post_drop = { why = 4 }
            }
            oe_col_post_count = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_col_upkeep_pts > 0 gold >= oe_col_upkeep }
            add_gold = { value = oe_col_upkeep multiply = -1 }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. The AI's roll (15 %; 30 % while D1's grain road is tight): the likeliest site (oe_col_ai_site_score) gets the same request as the action.
oe_col_post_ai_year = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_post_ai_ok = yes }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_col_ai_ch value = 15 }
        if = { limit = { oe_col_grain_tight = yes } save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_col_ai_ch value = 30 } }
        random = {
            chance = scope:oe_col_ai_ch
            oe_col_list_sites = yes
            ordered_in_list = {
                list = oe_col_sites
                limit = { oe_col_site_ok = yes }
                order_by = oe_col_ai_site_score
                max = 1
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = oe_col_pick_site
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_pick_site scope:oe_col_pick_site = { oe_col_site_ok = yes } }
                oe_col_request = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. OUR REQUEST to the likeliest site, free (no authority, no gold): the host's event oe_col.24 goes out, the answer oe_col.21 follows.
oe_col_test_req = {
    set_variable = oe_col_c_open
    oe_col_list_sites = yes
    ordered_in_list = {
        list = oe_col_sites
        limit = { oe_col_site_ok = yes }
        order_by = oe_col_host_ch
        max = 1
        check_range_bounds = no
        save_scope_as = oe_col_pick_site
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_pick_site scope:oe_col_pick_site = { oe_col_site_ok = yes } }
        oe_col_req_clear = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_req_paid value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_req_loc value = scope:oe_col_pick_site }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_req_due value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 2 } }
        scope:oe_col_pick_site = { owner ?= { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.24 } }
    }
}

# INTERFACE (design 3.6.2; the Roman Company's phase 2, design ref-company 3.12). BYZ scope. Input: scope:oe_col_land, a location, the seat (or BYZ var oe_col_fc_seat set by the caller); more land in the BYZ variable list oe_col_fc_more (optional); BYZ var oe_col_from_company = 1 (optional) when the Roman Company bought it. Light: it queues the founding and fires the hidden event oe_col.31, which does the work in scopes of its own. One at a time: while one waits (from an earlier month: dropped, failure code 5) a second call is refused (failure code 2).
oe_col_found_colonia = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_due var:oe_col_fc_due < oe_ml_month_now }
        oe_col_fc_clean = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_fc_fail value = 5 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_due } set_variable = { name = oe_col_fc_fail value = 2 } }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_land }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_fc_seat value = scope:oe_col_land }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_seat }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_fc_due value = oe_ml_month_now }
            trigger_event_silently = oe_col.31
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The founding's books are cleared (seat, list, marks on the land, the company's mark).
oe_col_fc_clean = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_seat } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_seat }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_due } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_due }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_from_company } remove_variable = oe_col_from_company }
    if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_col_fc_more } clear_variable_list = oe_col_fc_more }
    every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_col_seat saved, the land marked oe_col_fc_land. scope:oe_col_theme = a theme of the empire that already governs land in the seat's area, else one that governs a location next to the land (design 3.6.2 step 2: 'the same or a neighbouring area', taken as the area, then the neighbours); none: unset.
oe_col_fc_find_theme = {
    scope:oe_col_seat = {
        area = {
            random_location_in_area = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } oe_col_in_theme = yes }
                oe_col_save_theme = yes
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_col_theme } }
        every_owned_location = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
            random_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } oe_col_in_theme = yes }
                oe_col_save_theme = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_col.30 (must-fire, sent by the founding oe_col.31; no quiet months): takes the main-line month (line 16). Without Constantinople no popup: the books are cleared.
oe_col_fire_30 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_col_ev_ok_30 = yes location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        oe_col_count = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col.30
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_seat } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_seat }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_theme } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_theme }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_new } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_new }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp }
    }
}

# Location scope: a site with a post that Byzantium itself holds (oe_col_site_sync, once). Design 3.6.3: inside a theme's jurisdiction already (a campaign's theme, say) it only gets the colonia modifier; else, unless a founding failed here in the last 12 months or another one waits, the site is the seat and Byzantium's fit land of the same province goes with it (oe_col_found_colonia). The post keeps its level and points.
oe_col_site_colonia = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_colonia_at value = 2 }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_colonia_seat years = -1 mode = replace }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_col_fc_ok = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_cd }
            c:BYZ = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_due } }
        }
        save_scope_as = oe_col_land
        province = {
            every_location_in_province = {
                limit = { NOT = { this = scope:oe_col_land } oe_col_fc_ok = yes }
                save_scope_as = oe_col_fc_one
                c:BYZ = { add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_col_fc_more target = scope:oe_col_fc_one } }
            }
        }
        c:BYZ = { oe_col_found_colonia = yes }
    }
}

# Any scope. One debug-log line with phase 4a's state (test page, observer logger).
oe_col_log_p4 = {
    debug_log = "OE_COL p4 colonia=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_colonia_v')|0] fail=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_fc_fail').GetValue|0] pending=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_col_fc_pending_v')|0] new=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_c30_new').GetValue|0] cmp=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_col_c30_cmp').GetValue|0]"
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Phase 4a's books are cleared (waiting founding, failure code, count, marks and cooldowns on the land); themes, posts and modifiers already made stay.
oe_col_test_p4_reset = {
    oe_col_fc_clean = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_fail } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_fail }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_n } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_n }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_seat } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_seat }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_theme } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_theme }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_new } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_new }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp }
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = {
            OR = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_cd has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at has_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
    }
    location:tana = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
    }
    location:kaffa = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
    }
    location:trebizond = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
    }
    location:sinop = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
    }
    location:varna = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
    }
    location:chilia = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
    }
    location:famagusta = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_cd } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
    }
    location:alexandria = {

        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }

    location:beirut = {

        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_at } remove_variable = oe_col_colonia_at }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } remove_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
    }

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. The newest post whose site an AI holds (none: a free level-1 post at the likeliest site first) is handed to Byzantium (change_location_owner); the next sync makes it a colonia. Never a player's land, never the owner's capital.
oe_col_test_give = {
    oe_col_list_sites = yes
    ordered_in_list = {
        list = oe_col_sites
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post oe_col_give_ok = yes }
        order_by = oe_col_seq_v
        max = 1
        check_range_bounds = no
        save_scope_as = oe_col_pick_site
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_col_pick_site } }
        ordered_in_list = {
            list = oe_col_sites
            limit = { oe_col_site_ok = yes oe_col_give_ok = yes }
            order_by = oe_col_host_ch
            max = 1
            check_range_bounds = no
            save_scope_as = oe_col_pick_site
        }
        scope:oe_col_pick_site ?= { oe_col_post_open = yes }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:oe_col_pick_site
            scope:oe_col_pick_site = { has_variable = oe_col_post oe_col_give_ok = yes }
        }
        scope:oe_col_pick_site = { change_location_owner = c:BYZ }
    }
    oe_col_post_count = yes
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. oe_col_found_colonia for Byzantium's most populous land that no theme governs (not Constantinople).
oe_col_test_found = {
    ordered_owned_location = { limit = { oe_col_fc_ok = yes } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_col_land }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_land } oe_col_found_colonia = yes }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. The same, marked as land the Roman Company bought.
oe_col_test_found_cmp = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_col_from_company value = 1 }
    oe_col_test_found = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_seat } has_variable = oe_col_from_company }
        remove_variable = oe_col_from_company
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. oe_col.30 at once, text and options only: the seat is Byzantium's most populous land under a theme (not Constantinople), shown as a new theme; nothing is founded.
oe_col_test_fire_30 = {
    ordered_owned_location = {
        limit = { oe_col_in_theme = yes NOT = { this = location:constantinople } }
        order_by = population
        save_scope_as = oe_col_seat
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_seat }
        scope:oe_col_seat = { oe_col_save_theme = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_theme }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_c30_seat value = scope:oe_col_seat }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_c30_theme value = scope:oe_col_theme }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_c30_new value = 1 }
            oe_col_fire_30 = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly while the empire holds Constantinople. At most one optional event: the first of EVENT_ORDER whose turn comes (each takes the lock and starts the quiet months, so the rest wait).
oe_col_events = {
    oe_col_try_22 = yes
    oe_col_try_10 = yes
    oe_col_try_11 = yes
    oe_col_try_20 = yes
    oe_col_try_14 = yes
    oe_col_try_12 = yes
    oe_col_try_2 = yes
    oe_col_try_3 = yes
    oe_col_try_23 = yes
}

# BYZ scope, every January while the empire holds Constantinople (YEARLY).
oe_col_yearly = {
    oe_col_ai_year = yes
    oe_col_sons_year = yes
    oe_col_post_upkeep = yes
    oe_col_thr_year = yes
    oe_col_post_ai_year = yes
}

# BYZ scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py LINES, id 16 "col"); no hook of its own. Steps in order (MONTHLY): start the books, count the moves down, look at the trading posts (phase 3), then (while the empire holds Constantinople) the January work and the events. Without Constantinople only the books run.
oe_col_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_on } } oe_col_init = yes }
    oe_col_slot_tick = yes
    oe_col_post_sync = yes
    if = {
        limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
        if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_col_yearly = yes }
        oe_col_events = yes
    }
}
